product_one_liner.value: Authentic8's Silo provides secure, anonymous workspaces for threat-intelligence analysts, OSINT investigators, financial-crime teams and law enforcement to collect and analyze online content.

pricing_page.notes: Public plans and annual per-user pricing are available.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified in official customer success stories.

founded_year.notes: The company's About Us page states that it was established in 2010.

eng_blog.notes: The visible index contains OSINT and investigation guidance, rather than at least two engineer-authored posts about how Authentic8's product is built.

public_docs.notes: Its public knowledge base contains multiple product-support articles and API documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The listed openings are Governance Administration Specialist and Sales Development Representative, Commercial; neither is a qualifying AI, ML or data-science role.

model_provider.notes: The Nexus AI user guide explicitly identifies Google Vertex AI as its AI-processing service.

compliance_certs.notes: All five are named on its assurance page; these are public compliance claims, not equivalent types of certification.

last_funding.notes: Vistara Growth announced the US$12 million financing on October 8, 2025 and described it as a debt facility, rather than an equity round.

raised_18mo.notes: The US$12 million debt facility announced in October 2025 falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Sales Development Representative, Commercial is listed as a remote United States opening.

launched_6mo.notes: Silo Nexus AI v2 was announced on August 19, 2026, adding investigation roles, file-format support and workflow integrations.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Miguel Ramos started as Chief Product Officer in January 2026, following his Head of Product role; this was an internal promotion, not a new company hire.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Its SDR posting requires maintaining activity and opportunity tracking in Salesforce.
